author_reading.rationale: Eight unrelated input bits feed a two-stage bus capture; independent bit synchronizers do not preserve a coherent word.

rationale: SDC assigns d to clk_a and capture to asynchronous clk_b. Two stages per bit do not prove word coherence. No source encoding, stability, independence or consumer atomicity contract establishes whether a mixed word is forbidden. Disclose the coherence obligation rather than infer a functional defect from bus width. Physical synchronizer implementation and asynchronous reset release/recovery remain external obligations; neither SDC nor sampled digital simulation closes them.

Physical synchronizer and reset-release closure are separate obligations.
